description: Role-specific operational and statutory training modules for Zamorin Cafe ERP

modules.title: Primary Master Governance & Compliance Operations
competencies: Organisation and multi-café hierarchy provisioning
Statutory compliance review (GST Rule 46(b), ESI Rule 50, EPF 1952)
System health overview, maintenance mode and kill-switch control
Cryptographic audit log verification and leaver offboarding

modules.title: Owner Business Oversight, Finance & Multi-Branch Auditing
competencies: Real-time cross-café sales, margin, and revenue share visibility
Financial reconciliations, Z-Reports, and cash drawer variance audits
Purchase order and high-value expenditure authorization
Tamper-evident passbook and statutory tax filing review

modules.title: Café Manager Shift, Inventory & Procurement Controls
competencies: Register session opening, mid-day float check, and shift handover
FEFO inventory tracking, stock movements, and waste logging
Purchase order receipt, 3-way match, and vendor invoice verification
Operational exception handling and staff shift attendance reconciliation

modules.title: POS Counter Billing, Payments & Thermal Printing
competencies: POS order entry, modifier selection, and customer lookup
Multi-tender settlement (Cash, UPI QR, Card split payments)
Save & Print, offline resilience, and authorized receipt reprinting
Void handling with mandatory manager authorization and reason code

modules.title: Staff Attendance, Safety Protocol & Task Execution
competencies: Universal QR badge scan for duty punch-in and punch-out
Food safety temperature logging and checklist submission
Personal leave, advance requests, and digital payslip review
Incident and hazard reporting via in-app operational support
